steps.title: Confirm the NTNP category and worker eligibility
steps.description: The permanent, non-seasonal NWT offer must be TEER 0, 1, 2 or 3 and at least 30 hours weekly. The worker must meet Skilled Worker criteria, have an active federal Express Entry profile and validation code, and remain eligible in the pool. Language minimums are CLB/NCLC 7 for TEER 0 or 1 and CLB/NCLC 5 for TEER 2 or 3.

steps.title: Confirm the permanent NWT job offer
steps.description: The job must be permanent, non-seasonal, full-time and performed in the Northwest Territories. Remote work outside the NWT is not eligible. Duties must match the chosen NOC and wages must meet program standards.

requiredDocuments.title: Signed NWT employment contract and job description

steps.title: Confirm the NWT employer is eligible
steps.description: The employer must operate year-round from an NWT establishment, generally have operated full-time for at least one year, and remain in good standing with WSCC and Employment Standards or the applicable collective agreement.

steps.title: Complete recruitment and LMIA checks
steps.description: The employer provides a positive LMIA or the required local and national advertising evidence. The exact advertising period depends on the category, and the advertised duties and wage must match the offered job.

requiredDocuments.title: LMIA or required advertising and recruitment results

steps.title: Prepare personal, education and language evidence
steps.description: Collect passport and civil records, work permit or maintained-status evidence if in Canada, three months of financial records and pay stubs where applicable, education or ECA, licences, work history and valid language results.

steps.title: Create the Employer-Driven Expression of Interest
steps.description: After the employer registers in the portal, the foreign worker completes the EOI survey. It is a profile, not an application, and remains in the pool for up to 12 months if not selected.
